        // java.log("漫画标题: " + comicTitle.text());
        // java.log("结束标题: " + endTitle.text());

            "title": "小说",
            "url": "",
            "style": {
                "layout_flexGrow": 1,

            }
        });

        // 提取小说子分类

                    if (span) {
                        name = span.text().trim();
                    } else {
                        name = link.text().trim();
                    }

                    // 提取链接（保持原始相对或绝对路径）
                    var href = link.attr('href');

                    if (name && href) {
                        // 仅确保链接包含分页参数，不处理相对链接转换
                        if (!href.includes("{{page}}")) {
                            href = href + "/{{page}}";
                        }

                        results.push({
                            "title": name,
                            "url": href,
                            "style": {
                                "layout_flexGrow": 1,
                                "layout_flexBasisPercent": 0.25
                            }
                        });
                        fictionCount++;
                        //   java.log("添加小说子分类: " + name + " -> " + href);
                    }
                }
            }

            currentElement = currentElement.nextElementSibling();
        }

        //  java.log("小说子分类数量: " + fictionCount);

        // 2. 添加"漫画"大类
        results.push({
            "title": "漫画",
            "url": "",
            "style": {

                "layout_flexBasisPercent": 1
            }
        });

        // 提取漫画子分类

        currentElement = comicTitle.nextElementSibling();
        var comicCount = 0;

        while (currentElement && !currentElement.equals(endTitle)) {
            if (currentElement.hasClass('layui-tab-item-tagContainer')) {
                //   java.log("找到漫画tagContainer");

                var links = currentElement.select('a');
                //   java.log("漫画容器中有" + links.size() + "个链接");

                for (var i = 0; i < links.size(); i++) {
                    var link = links.get(i);

                    // 提取名称

                    var name = '';
                    if (span) {
                        name = span.text().trim();
                    } else {
                        name = link.text().trim();
                    }

                    // 提取链接（保持原始相对或绝对路径）
                    var href = link.attr('href');

                    if (name && href) {
                        // 仅确保链接包含分页参数，不处理相对链接转换
                        if (!href.includes("{{page}}")) {
                            href = href + "/{{page}}";
                        }

                        results.push({
                            "title": name,
                            "url": href,
                            "style": {
                                "layout_flexGrow": 1,
                                "layout_flexBasisPercent": 0.25
                            }
                        });
                        comicCount++;
                        //   java.log("添加漫画子分类: " + name + " -> " + href);
                    }
                }
            }

            currentElement = currentElement.nextElementSibling();
        }

        //   java.log("漫画子分类数量: " + comicCount);

        // 第五步：返回JSON
        // java.log("\n最终生成的发现地址规则:");
        // java.log(JSON.stringify(results, null, 2));
        return JSON.stringify(results);
    } catch (e) {
        return "" + e;
    }
})();

loadDocType="{{@@body@data-doctype}}";
loadType="{{@@body@data-randomtype}}";
sid=baseUrl.match(/(\d+).html/)[1];
url=baseUrl.replace(/\d+.html/,'')

var section = {
    loadDocType: loadDocType,
    loadType: loadType,
    sid:sid,
    content: {
        childNode: [],
        
        init: function(c){
            this.body=c
            if (section.loadType == 'normal') {
      this.load(String(java.base64Decode(java.getString('//*[@name="client"]/@content'))))
            } else if (section.loadType == 'substep') {
                var d = 'r' + section.sid;
                var f = false;
                if (section.loadDocType == 'xml') {
                    d += '.xml'
                } else if (section.loadDocType == 'json') {
                    d += '.json';
                    f = true
                } else {
                    return false
                };        
             cookie="PHPSESSID="+java.get(baseUrl,{}).cookie("PHPSESSID");
            token= java.get(url+d,{"X-Requested-With": "XMLHttpRequest","referer":baseUrl,"cookie":String(cookie)}).header("token")                
                	this.load(token)      	
            } else {
                return false
            };               
        },
        load: function(a) {         
            a = String(java.base64Decode(a)).split(/[A-Z]+%/);      
            var b = 0,
            start = 0;
            for (var i = 0; i < this.body.length; i++) {
                if (String(this.body[i]).match(/h2/i)) {
                    start = i + 1
                };
                if (String(this.body[i]).match(/div/i)&& this.body[i].attr("class") != 'chapter') {
                    break
                }
            };
          
            for (var i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
                if (a[i] < 5) {
                    this.childNode[a[i]] = this.body[i + start];
                      b++
                } else {
                    this.childNode[a[i] - b] = this.body[i + start]                 
                }
            };
  }
}
}
section.content.init(java.getElement("@@id.content@children!0").toArray());
section.content.childNode.join("")
</js>

  }
}

version:1.3
last_updateTime:2025.11.3

/*
搜索模式默认是搜小说
需要漫画则在关键字前加m:即m:系统
小说则为n:系统
听书则为t:系统 （该模式为真人听书）
短剧则为d:系统
使用该搜索方式后，需要登录自行切换至小说模式
*/

ruleBookInfo.author: author
ruleBookInfo.init:
<js>
t = Map('自定义音色：') ? Map('自定义音色：') : source.get('tone');
source.put('tone',t)
result
</js>

ruleBookInfo.name: book_name

ruleContent.content:
<js>
var id = java.hexDecodeToString(result);
var type = source.get('type');
var tone = source.get('tone');

let url = source.key + "content?item_id=" + id + "&type=" + type;
let url1 = source.key + "page?item_id=" + id
if (type == 'novel'||type == '') {
	let result = java.ajax(url);
  result=JSON.parse(result).content;
} else if (type == 'comic') {
  let result = java.ajax(url);
  result=JSON.parse(result).content;
} else if (type == 'audio'||type == 'novelaudio') {
	let urls = url + "&tone_id=" + tone;
	java.log(urls)
  let result = java.ajax(urls);
  result=JSON.parse(result).content;
  if (result==''){java.longToast('该书不支持当前音色，请更换并刷新');result}
} else if (type == 'video') {
  if (book['durChapterIndex'] == chapter['index']) {
    java.startBrowser(url1, '播放器')
    java.toast('\n✅正在加载视频，请耐心等待')
  }
  `【刷新正文】播放视频\n`
  }
</js>

ruleExplore.author: $.author||$.copyright
ruleExplore.bookList:
<js>
let tp = (baseUrl.match(/genre_type=(\d)/) || [, '0'])[1];
source.put('tp',tp)
function getBookIdFull(url) {
	const {java} = this
	$ = JSON.parse(url).data
	if ($.book_shelf_info != 0 && $.book_shelf_info != undefined) {
		arr = $.book_shelf_info.map($ => $.book_id)
	} else if (list = $.data_list != 0 && $.data_list != undefined)  {
		arr = $.data_list.map($ => $.book_id_str)
	} else {
		java.toast("获取 book_id 失败，你可能需要登录！")
	}
	return arr
}
let ck = "sessionid=" + (String(cookie.getKey("fanqienovel.com", "sessionid")) ? String(cookie.getKey("fanqienovel.com", "sessionid")) : (source.getLoginInfoMap() ? source.getLoginInfoMap() : {})['手动登录Token'])

getShelf = () => {
let book_shelf_url = 'https://fanqienovel.com/reading/bookapi/bookshelf/info/v:version/?aid=1967&iid=0&version_code=57700&update_version_code=57700'
let book_shelf_info = java.ajax(book_shelf_url + ', ' + JSON.stringify({
  headers: {
    'Cookie': ck
  }
}))

let arrB = []
for (let i of JSON.parse(book_shelf_info).data.book_shelf_info) {
  arrB.push(i.book_id)
}
write_config('bookshelf.' + read_config('userinfo.userid'), arrB)

bid = getBookIdFull(book_shelf_info)
let id_list = splitArray(bid, 100)
let urls = []
id_list.forEach(i => {
    urls.push(source.key + "/multi-detail?book_id=" + i.join(","))
})

res = java.ajaxAll(urls)
let resp = {book_info: []}
res.forEach(r => {
  resp.book_info = resp.book_info.concat(JSON.parse(r.body()).data)
})

return resp
}

function getByGroupName(name) {
  let book_shelf_url = 'https://fanqienovel.com/reading/bookapi/bookshelf/info/v:version/?aid=1967&iid=0&version_code=57700&update_version_code=57700'

  let book_shelf_info = JSON.parse(java.ajax(book_shelf_url + ', ' + JSON.stringify({
    headers: {
      'Cookie': ck,
    }
  })))
  let group_bookids = {
    "组外": []
  }
  book_shelf_info.data.book_shelf_info.forEach(i => {
    if (!group_bookids[i.group_name ? i.group_name : "组外"]) group_bookids[i.group_name] = []
    group_bookids[i.group_name ? i.group_name : "组外"].push(i.book_id)
  })
  // java.log(JSON.stringify(group_bookids["组外"]))
  // java.log(decodeURIComponent(name))
  if (!group_bookids[decodeURIComponent(name)]) return {data: []}
  //java.log("awa")
  let book_ids = splitArray(group_bookids[decodeURIComponent(name)], 100)
  let urls = []

  book_ids.forEach(i => {
    urls.push(source.key + "/multi-detail?book_id=" + i.join(","))
  })
  
  res = java.ajaxAll(urls)

  let resp = {book_info: []}
  res.forEach(r => {
    resp.book_info = resp.book_info.concat(JSON.parse(r.body()).data)
  })

  return resp
}

function getByTabIndex(index) {
  let url = _mlsec.requestHeader(
	  "bookmall/tab",
    "version_name=5.8.9.32",
	  null,
	  ck
  )
  let all = JSON.parse(java.ajax(url))
  let tab = all.data.tab_item[0].cell_data[index].cell_data
  if (!tab) tab = []
  let bookList = []
  for (let i of tab) {
    bookList = bookList.concat(i.book_data)
    // java.log(JSON.stringify(i.book_data))
  }
  return { book_info: bookList }
}

if (baseUrl.endsWith("bookshelf")) result = getShelf("bookshelf/info")
else {
  let w = baseUrl.split("/")
  if (baseUrl.includes("groupName")) {
    result = getByGroupName(w[w.length - 1])
  } else if (baseUrl.includes("tab")) {
    result = getByTabIndex(parseInt(w[w.length - 1]))
  } else result = JSON.parse(result)
}


JSON.stringify({
  data: result.book_list || result.book_info || result.data.result ||
        result.data.book_info || result.detail_list || result.data
});

</js>
$..video_info[*]||$..book_data[*]||$.data[*]

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
let data=JSON.parse(result).data
let chapterList=[]
for(var volume of data){
	chapterList.push({
		name:volume.volume_name,
		isVolume:true,
		info:volume.volume_desc
		})
		for(var chapter of volume.chapter_list){
			var isVip=chapter.chapter_ispay==0?"":"💰"
			var time=java.timeFormat(chapter.chapter_time*1000)
			chapterList.push({
				name:isVip+chapter.chapter_name,
				isVolume:false,
				info:`更新时间:`+time+` 字数:${chapter.chapter_number}`,
				url:`/api/readWithEncrypt?chapter_id=${chapter.chapter_id}&nid=${chapter.chapter_nid}&preload=0`
				})
			}
	}
chapterList
</js>

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
let data=JSON.parse(result).data
let chapterList=[]
for(var volume of data){
	chapterList.push({
		name:volume.volume_name,
		isVolume:true,
		info:volume.volume_desc
		})
		for(var chapter of volume.chapter_list){
			var isVip=chapter.chapter_ispay==0?"":"💰"
			var time=java.timeFormat(chapter.chapter_time*1000)
			chapterList.push({
				name:isVip+chapter.chapter_name,
				isVolume:false,
				info:`更新时间:`+time+` 字数:${chapter.chapter_number}`,
				url:`/api/readWithEncrypt?chapter_id=${chapter.chapter_id}&nid=${chapter.chapter_nid}&preload=0`
				})
			}
	}
chapterList
</js>

var option = {};

{
    var e = es[it];
    var k = e.attr('name');
    var v = e.attr('value');
    if (k == sk) {
        //body+=sk+'={{java.encodeURI(key,\''+ charset+'\');}}&';
        body += sk + '={{key}}&';
    }
    else {
        body += k + '=' + v + '&';
    }
}
es = form.select('select[name]');
for (it in es)
{
    var e = es[it];
    var k = e.attr('name');
    var v = e.select('option')[0].attr('value');
    body += k + '=' + v + '&';
}
body = String(body).replace(/&$/, '');
java.log(body);
if (method.match(/post/i))
{
    option = 
    {
        "charset" : String(charset), "method" : String(method), "body" : String(body), "headers" : headers, 
        "webView" : true 
    };
    url += ',' + JSON.stringify(option);
}
else
{
    //get
    option = {
        "charset" : String(charset), "headers" : headers, "webView" : true 
    };
    url += '?' + body + ',' + JSON.stringify(option);
}
java.log(url);
</js>

			   name:text,href:url,volume:false
		   }))
		 }
	 }
}

    Packages.javax.crypto,

);

    let IV_PARAMETER = String("1ae2c94b");
    let ALGORITHM = "DES"; 
    let CIPHER_ALGORITHM = "DES/CBC/PKCS5Padding";
    let CHARSET = "utf-8";
    let password=String("KK!%G3JdCHJxpAF3%Vg9pN");


function decode(data){
let dks = new DESKeySpec(String(password).getBytes());
let keyFactory = SecretKeyFactory.getInstance("DES");
let secretKey = keyFactory.generateSecret(dks);
let cipher = Cipher.getInstance(CIPHER_ALGORITHM);
let iv = new IvParameterSpec(IV_PARAMETER.getBytes(CHARSET));
cipher.init(Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, secretKey, iv);
return new String(cipher.doFinal(Base64.getDecoder().decode(String(data).getBytes(CHARSET))), CHARSET);

}
}
//DES解密结束
